message:
So there are no handlers for `v128.const`, `ref.null`, `ref.func` in the objdump reader. This means if an init expr contains one of these opcodes, `OnOpcode` will push an `InitInst` to `insts` (making `insts.size() == 1`), but `type` will never be set, remaining uninitialized.

Then in `EndInitExpr` → `InitExprToConstOffset`, since `insts.size() == 1`, it reads `expr.type` which is uninitialized → MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value.

Now I need to craft a WASM binary that triggers this. The crash is in `EndElemSegmentInitExpr` (from the crash state), so I need an **elem segment** with an init expr that contains an opcode that doesn't set `type`.

Let me look at how elem segments are parsed in the binary reader to understand the format:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -n "BeginElemSegment\|OnElemSegmentElemExpr\|ElemSegment" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/wabt/src/binary-reader.cc | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
